The determinant criterion leaves uniform geometric factor-orbit classification and separate primitive degrees open. declarations.name: Theorem U1. The only imprimitive possibility at the first deficit
declarations.scope: For all admissible minimal full-cycle polynomial passports with k>=1 non-transposition factors of index>=2, s>=1 literal transpositions, p nontrivial cycles in the k factors, and s=p-k-1: k>=2; every imprimitive tuple has exactly s1,k2,p4 and passport(a^2 1^(2b-2)),(b^2 1^(2a-2)),T on2m sheets,m=a+b-1,a,b>=2. Its canonical normal transposition blocks have size2. Every other tuple at this level has actual S_N, only block counts1,N and deck1. Proof uses equality in the return budget, not a finite census.

declarations.name: Theorem U2. The complete imprimitive component
declarations.scope: For every a,b>=2 the exceptional passport has exactly one imprimitive full component: actual S2 wr K, with K=A_m if both a,b odd and K=S_m otherwise; all blocks1,m,2m and deck2. With W=3*(2-indicator(a=b)), its literal size is W*m^2, absolute W*m. Every remaining component is S_(2m), deck1; combined literal size W*m^2*((2a-1)*(2b-1)-1). The separate number of primitive components is not asserted uniformly.

declarations.name: Theorem U3. One determinant indexes all first-deficit components
declarations.scope: At every positive first deficit s=p-k-1, set F_li=sum residues of z^l/Q over color i,l0..k-1. Let T be its first k-1 rows and Delta the determinant after removing one column. Full components are exactly finite label-group orbits of geometric irreducible factors of Delta meeting rankF=k-1,rankT=k-2 and all exact good-polynomial exclusions. Lower feasible ranks have incidence dimension<=p-delta+1

declarations.name: Proposition U4. The degree-six determinant separates the two groups
declarations.scope: For a=b2, with ordered first critical pair0,1 and secondx,y, U=x+y-1,V=xy, the determinant is 2U*P/[V^3*(V-U)^3], P=-3V^2+U*(2U+3)*V-(U+1)*U^2. U is exactly the imprimitive component. P is geometrically irreducible by w=V/U and nonsquare ordered-root discriminant -w*(w-1)*(15w^2-15w+4)/(2w-1)^2. This gives the two components with literal27/216 and absolute9/36 independently of a global imported component theorem.

declarations.name: Proposition U5. Complete bounded first-deficit controls
declarations.scope: For every2<=a<=b<=5, the exceptional passport has exactly two full components with the U2 imprimitive size and one S_(2m) component of the aggregate primitive size. Complete bounded controls only. Additionally degree8 DT,DT,3,T is one S8 component of38400 literal tuples and degree9 DT,DT,DT,T,T is one S9 component of1771470 literal tuples. Independent ordered hook totals are exhausted by signed colored-braid absolute closures and cyclic literal multiplicities.
